dogecoin.text:
Speaking of Market Psychology.... checking in on dogecoin millionaires... erm... former millionaries.

Don't be greedy. https://t.co/ad3CWPFFuU

We are 30 days away from the 1 year anniversary of Elon announcing the Tesla BTC purchase, only for him to then shill dogecoin & lose his backbone falling prey to the FUDsters within a few short months.

How do you think the Dogecoin Millionaire is doing?

Answer: probably fine. When you get hundreds of thousands of followers shilling a token and become an influencer, I'm sure you are doing just fine
